benchmarks.warning: CTR 0.03-0.10 pct and CPC $2-11 across all awareness ad sets - the portfolio drag; every ad in the worst-10 list is an Awareness or unscored social ad.

benchmarks.note: Scaled UGC/AI video winners hold 0.45-0.68 thumb-stop; JB-UGC-4-irish peaks at 0.676.

creative_learnings.title: Identity-first hooks win
creative_learnings.detail: Top UGC scripts open with identity - I am a mom, I am 76, I am an herbalist, I shop at Target - then follow: Identity, relatable routine or problem, curiosity, product reveal, one meaningful transformation, proof (taste or science), simple CTA.

creative_learnings.title: Specific curiosity beats withholding
creative_learnings.detail: Rydel July (coffee popsicle, relatable premise) reached 100.5K vs June mystery hook 73.7K, a 36 pct reach lift; skip rate improved even though the product appeared later.

creative_learnings.title: Three organic retention modes
creative_learnings.detail: Comedy earns retention (Maryandbri), authentic messengers lower skip (Nadja, 34 pct skip), educational content wins saves and shares (Jess, herbalist authority + cortisol science).

creative_learnings.title: Hook fixed the funnel in June
creative_learnings.detail: Skip rate fell 57.5 to 45.3 pct May to June; 57 pct passed the hook vs 38; high-intent 75 pct-watched views rose 53 pct (32K to 49K); cost per reach improved $0.065 to $0.057. Only about 6 pct of views reach 75 pct of the video.

creative_learnings.title: Menopause and cortisol angles carry paid Sales
creative_learnings.detail: goodbye menopausal weight gain ($2,960 spend, $0.62 per initiate-checkout), women over 50 calm cortisol ($2,111, $0.81), GLP-1 no thanks ($1,446, $0.67), say hello toned arms ($2,010, $0.80), what i bought at target UGC static ($2,847, $0.86) are the scaled winners.

creative_learnings.title: AI videos: high CTR, expensive delivery
creative_learnings.detail: AI video ad set runs CTR 6.7-7.6 pct but CPM $23-24 and $0.90-1.22 per initiate-checkout; woman in car with vahdam cup scaled to $2,223 at $0.90.

creative_learnings.title: Awareness objective is the drag
creative_learnings.detail: All 10 worst cost-per-result ads with $100+ spend are Awareness/unscored social ads (CPC $2.10-$9.10, CTR 0.03-0.10 pct). Recommendation on the data: reallocate to Sales/Traffic structures that already clear the $0.80 benchmark.

creative_learnings.title: JoinBrands UGC traffic is the cheapest click in the account
creative_learnings.detail: Traffic - UGCset1 (40+ US): 12.18 pct CTR at $0.07 CPC across $1,311 spend; JB-UGC-4-irish alone: 16.37 pct CTR, $0.05 CPC, 0.676 thumb-stop.

executive_overview: The USA paid program sells VAHDAM ashwagandha coffee through two retail funnels: Target (Meta + TikTok ads into page-deck and PDP funnels, in-house statics + scored JoinBrands UGC + whitelisted influencers) and Costco (dark posts to the Indian diaspora in the US, landing on the Instacart PDP). Paid spend May 1 to July 20 was $45,870.61 (Meta $41,515.53 across 125 ads in 13 campaigns; TikTok $4,355.08, June only). The Sales engine clears its own benchmark ($0.80 per initiate-checkout on in-house statics; $0.73 on influencer page-deck), JoinBrands UGC traffic delivers the cheapest clicks in the account ($0.07), and Awareness structures are the portfolio drag (CTR 0.03-0.10 pct at $2-9 CPC). Organic ran 3.59M views / 1.58M reach Apr to Jul 17 on $150,956 total creator cost (69 influencers, 367 UGC videos; 300+ UGC pieces produced monthly). The creator- performance dashboard is fully automated (JoinBrands + Snowflake + mapping sheet); ad-campaign information is owned by Kritagya Prakash going forward, with Samvita leading paid and Anchit executing Target Meta. A consultant repository (for Megan) collates every report; priority explorations are Spins seasonality, August demos, Ibotta redeemer targeting, and the USA DTC coffee-launch email.

narratives.title: KT thread 1 - UGC Dashboard Automation
narratives.overview: The creator-performance dashboard went from manual builds to a one-skill automation; access and ownership were being settled.
details: Jul 14 - Aviral: the UGC creator-performance dashboard is automated end-to-end. One skill produces the full sheet (columns A to AN) as a live snapshot: posted Instagram Reels + TikTok posts pulled from JoinBrands, Meta + TikTok ad spend joined from Snowflake, organic scores and ad-recommendation logic computed, Excel built.

Three prerequisites: (1) install and run the skill; (2) fill and maintain the Video ID to Ad ID mapping sheet - Meta/TikTok ad tables do not store the source video ID, so without it spend/impressions/clicks/CTR/CPC cannot be attributed to a creator (the one ongoing manual task); (3) Snowflake connected per user before running - Meta from VAHDAM_DB.MAPLEMONK, TikTok from DATON.RAW.
One-time setup: Chrome connector signed into JoinBrands and Instagram for the organic pull.

Target Ads sheet: 125 ad rows, 44 columns (reach, impressions, outbound clicks/CTR, CPC, CPM, landing page views, results + indicator, cost per result, frequency, quality/engagement/conversion rankings, thumb-stop ratio, budgets, IDs).
This workbook feeds the Campaigns & Ads tab and every benchmark; the committed copy is data/ads/target-ads-meta-2026-07-20.json.

narratives.title: KT file 5 - Social Update USA deck (17 Jul)
narratives.overview: Organic, influencer and UGC performance: June was the breakout month and the hook was the reason.
details: Monthly organic: May 1.15M views / 655K reach; June 2.14M views / 775K reach; July 293K views / 154K reach by the 17th.
Creator economics: 69 influencers at $107,648 (62 live); 367 UGC videos at $43,308 (parked for 400 creators); total creator cost $150,956, utilized $69,948; organic CPR $0.04-0.10.

Retention funnel May vs June (Instagram): skip rate 57.5 to 45.3 pct; passed-hook 38 to 57 pct; 75 pct-watched views +53 pct (32K to 49K); cost per reach $0.065 to $0.057. Only ~6 pct of views reach 75 pct of the video.

Creator learnings: identity-first openers (mom / 76 / herbalist / Target shopper); specific curiosity beats withholding (Rydel July +36 pct reach); comedy retains (Maryandbri), authenticity lowers skip (Nadja), education earns saves (Jess).

June UGC buckets (136 live): Target shelf 41, Cortisol 30, Over 40 20, Gummies vs coffee 16, Taste 16, countering-mushroom 13. Next line-up: 10 influencers + 500 UGC creators; Costco Bay Area 12 influencers + 100 UGC.
